title: Recognize Engram's documented Windows test entry (pwsh scripts/test-rust.ps1) as a test route for verification credit
outcome: A registered run whose command is a repository's declared or documented test wrapper (first case: Engram's `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/test-rust.ps1 …`, its AGENTS.md Windows replacement for scripts/test-rust.sh) earns test verification through a supported route, without relabelling or accepting arbitrary commands.
acceptance: A behavioural test shows a registered run of a repository's declared Windows test wrapper, with its declared result artifact, produces a test verification record, while an undeclared arbitrary command still does not.
The chosen route is documented in docs/features/declared-test-commands.md, including how Engram declares scripts/test-rust.ps1; no relabelling of unclassified runs.
disposal_reason: Withdrawn by the requester (Engram::Fable, ebe242f7 #7644). Engram's own docs/development.md (lines 1113-1116) document that only a focused `cargo test` is classified as a test and that anything else is `other`, so refusing to classify the pwsh scripts/test-rust.ps1 wrapper is documented behaviour, not a TermAl defect. The fix was Engram's command choice: rerun as a direct cargo test.
